column2: [troublemaker_child.GetFirstName] snatched my wooden sword in the yard and will not give it back. [troublemaker_child.GetSheHe] is laughing and waving it over [troublemaker_child.GetHerHis] head, daring me to come and take it.
Knock [troublemaker_child.GetHerHim] down and take it back!

[shy_child.GetFirstName] never plays with the rest of us. [shy_child.GetSheHe] sits under the stairs with a book, and the bigger children pull [shy_child.GetHerHis] hair and throw [shy_child.GetHerHis] books in the moat.
I will teach [shy_child.GetHerHim] to stand up for [shy_child.GetHerHim]self.
Books are for the dull. Leave [shy_child.GetHerHim] to them.
[From.GetFirstName] says the next time the big children come for my books I must hit the biggest one on the nose, as hard as I can, and the rest will run away.

[From.GetFirstName] has offered me [From.GetHerHis] wooden sword, so that the others will leave me alone. It is chipped, and the hilt is wrapped in string, and it is the best thing anyone has ever given me.
I do not want it. Swords are for brutes.
I told [From.GetFirstName] to stand up for [From.GetHerHim]self, and [From.GetSheHe] did. The first nose [From.GetSheHe] hit, as hard as [From.GetSheHe] could, was mine.
Well struck! I taught you that.

My guardian caught me asleep in the hayloft when I should have been at my letters, and was reaching for the switch when [helping_child.GetFirstName] spoke up and swore it was [helping_child.GetHerHis] fault for keeping me up all night.
Own up. It was my laziness, not [helping_child.GetHerHis].
I took a thrashing that was meant for [From.GetFirstName], and [From.GetSheHe] has not stopped thanking me since.
I took a thrashing that was meant for [From.GetFirstName], and [From.GetSheHe] told everyone I should mind my own business.
Ingrate! I will never help [From.GetHerHim] again.

[shy_courtier.GetFirstName] goes red as a beet whenever a lady so much as says good morning to him. Last night at supper one asked him to pass the salt and he knocked over a jug of wine and fled the hall.
Offer to teach him a few things.
[From.GetFirstName], who can talk to any lady at court and make her laugh, has offered to teach me how it is done.
I can manage alone, thank you!
I offered to help [From.GetFirstName] with the ladies, and he told me to keep my nose out of his affairs.
I offered to help [From.GetFirstName] with the ladies, and he thanked me very politely and said no.
Every lady at court looks straight through me. [lustful_courtier.GetFirstName], on the other hand, has them laughing at every word. Perhaps he could tell me how.
[From.GetFirstName] has asked me, red to the ears, to teach him how to talk to women.
Such secrets do not come cheap.
[From.GetFirstName] will teach me everything he knows about women, for ten gold pieces.
I keep my pride and my purse.
[From.GetFirstName] has pressed a purse into my hand and begged me to teach him how to talk to women.
Throw the purse back at him.
Take the money and teach him.
Give it back and teach him as a friend.

The lessons from [From.GetFirstName] are humiliating. I have had to bow to a broom, compliment a hound and recite poetry to the cook. But last night, a lady laughed at something I said, and not unkindly.
There may be hope for me yet.
[child_2.GetFirstName] is reading the same book as me, the one about the dragon and the seven knights, and has already worked out who poisoned the old king.
There can only be one cleverest girl at court.
[From.GetFirstName] wants to be my friend. We like the same books and the same games, and she is nearly as clever as me.
Never. She copies everything I do.
[target_courtier.GetFirstName] flutters her eyelashes at every page and squire at court, and they follow her about like puppies. When I try, they ask if I have something in my eye.
[From.GetFirstName], who never says a word to a boy, has asked me to teach her how to make them follow her about.

[target_courtier.GetFirstName] flirts with every man at court, married or not, and somehow everyone adores her for it. If I so much as smile at a knight, the gossip goes round the court twice before supper.
[From.GetFirstName], who blushes if a man so much as looks at her, has asked me how I make them all fall over themselves.
[From.GetFirstName] has taken me under her wing. I have learned more about men in a week than in all my life.
[From.GetFirstName] gave me a few hints, kindly enough, and then went back to her admirers.
[From.GetFirstName] laughed when I asked her for help, and told everyone at court.
[target_courtier.GetFirstName] put me on my back in the sword yard in three strokes, in front of everyone, and is still grinning about it.
[target_courtier.GetFirstName] trips me in the corridors, puts frogs in my bed and calls me names in front of the others. I do not even know what I did.
[From.GetFirstName], whom I have been tormenting for weeks, has offered me a honey cake.
Eat it, and put a frog in [From.GetHerHis] bed anyway.
[From.GetFirstName] ate my honey cake and put a frog in my bed anyway.
At least I tried to be kind.
Try once more. Everyone needs a friend.
[From.GetFirstName] ate my honey cake and has not bothered me since. Yesterday [From.GetSheHe] even said good morning.

I cannot stand [target_courtier.GetFirstName]. The way [target_courtier.GetSheHe] laughs, the way [target_courtier.GetSheHe] eats, the way everyone likes [target_courtier.GetHerHim]. I do not know why. I just cannot.
[From.GetFirstName] walked up to me in the yard and told me, in front of everyone, that [From.GetSheHe] cannot stand me.
I do not care what [From.GetSheHe] thinks.
[From.GetFirstName] wants to know what [From.GetSheHe] ever did to me. I cannot think of a single thing.
[From.GetFirstName] says I never did anything to [From.GetHerHim], and wants to start again.
I asked [From.GetFirstName] what I ever did to [From.GetHerHim]. "You exist," [From.GetSheHe] said.
I heard one of the other children at court say the gods are a story for babies, and that the priests only want our money. I nearly fainted.
Show the poor fool the light.
[From.GetFirstName] has followed me about all day, telling me about the gods, the saints and what happens to children who laugh at them.
Pretend to see the light, so [From.GetSheHe] will stop.
I have brought [From.GetFirstName] to the gods! [From.GetSheHe] says [From.GetSheHe] will pray every night from now on.
[From.GetFirstName] came to the shrine with me today, and prayed, and meant it. I have saved a soul.
The ladies of the court gathered round [embroidery_prodigy.GetFirstName]'s needlework today, a stag hunt in seven colours. Nobody looked at mine.
Unpick her stitches in the night.
Someone crept into the solar in the night and unpicked my stag hunt, three months of work, stitch by stitch. [From.GetFirstName] cannot stop smiling.
[From.GetFirstName] has asked me to teach her my stitches.
My doll is gone! [doll_stealer.GetFirstName] has it, I know it, I saw it under her arm this morning.
[From.GetFirstName] has found out that I took her doll and wants it back.
Give it back, and say sorry.
Give it back. It is ugly anyway.
[From.GetFirstName] does not get her doll back.
[From.GetFirstName] gave my doll back and said she was sorry, and we played with it together all afternoon.
[From.GetFirstName] gave my doll back and said it was ugly anyway.
[From.GetFirstName] will not give my doll back. She says finders keepers.
At least I have my doll.
I will get her for this!
[fellow_crusader.GetTitledFirstName] rides beside me on this holy war, sworn to the same faith and the same vow. Tomorrow we meet the enemy.
This crusade is not mine. I am going home.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] knelt beside me all night before the battle and prayed until dawn. Some say [From.GetSheHe] prayed more loudly than [From.GetSheHe] needed to.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] rode ahead of me into the enemy and took the banner I was riding for. The whole army is singing [From.GetHerHis] name.
A rival for the same glory.
This crusade is not mine. I am going home.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] tells anyone who will listen that my prayers before the battle were for show.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] tells anyone who will listen that I stole the banner from under [From.GetHerHis] nose.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] came to me after the battle and said that my prayers had steadied [From.GetHerHis] hand.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] came to me after the battle and raised a cup to the one who took the banner.
I want a seat on my liege's council, and [bond_mentor.GetTitledFirstName] already has one. No one knows the work better.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] wants to learn my craft. Whether it is to serve the realm or to take my seat, [From.GetSheHe] did not say.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] has taught me more of the council's work in a season than I learned in years, and we have become friends over the ledgers.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] taught me well enough, but never once turned [From.GetHerHis] back on me.
[bond_mother.GetTitledFirstName] is with child too, and as uncomfortable as I am. We have taken to sitting together in the garden with our feet up, complaining.
Rest, and keep my own counsel.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] and I sit in the garden every afternoon, comparing ankles and arguing over names.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] will find out after the birth.
Since the babies came, [From.GetTitledFirstName] has not had a moment for me. I suppose the garden and the complaining were all [From.GetSheHe] wanted.
[From.GetFirstName] and I are friends now! We are going to build a fort in the woods and nobody else is allowed in.
[From.GetFirstName] is my enemy now, forever and ever.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] has made it plain that we are rivals.
